quotes.verbatim: '''SDPC Spin''' is an opener invented by Ecchou. It sends the same amount of attack as [[Stickspin]], but has a simpler third bag.
The first bag is stacked the same way as [[SDPC]].
There are two main ways to stack the third bag. The first is always possible, but the second results in a flatter stack.
If S comes before O, the third build can also be stacked.
If the first build or third build is used, the center area must be filled in to complete the T-Spin Double. This can be done freestyle or using the [[STMB Cave]] continuation below.
===First C-Spin build===
'''[[STMB Cave]] into [[STSD]]'''
Created by stickmancomic.
This requires the first build to be taken for the third bag.
J needs to come before at least two of T, L, and Z.
Alternatively, one can build a [[Trinity]] on the fifth bag, leaving cleaner residue.
From here it is possible to upstack or [[Donation|donate]] a TSD.
===Second C-Spin build===
Covers 73.33% of all bags.
If Z comes too early, one can sometimes put Z on top of the J piece.
'''Alternate fourth bag'''
If I is saved, there is a 68.10% chance of being able to do a 12-line perfect clear.
quotes.note: no 12-line PC is drawn; nothing here re-derives 68.10%

quotes.verbatim: Otherwise, one can transition into [[6-3]] or [[5-4]].
'''DT Cannon continuation'''
One can build a DT Cannon with the residue after completing the C-Spin.
'''First build'''
Covers 91.67% of all fifth bags, leading into 6-3.
'''Second builds'''
Made by swng.
'''O before L'''
'''L before O'''
===Third C-Spin build===
An [[Imperial Cross]] can sometimes be built.
From here, there is a 99.68% chance of a 14-line Perfect Clear with 4 minimals.
quotes.note: 14 is re-derived along the base chain (`lines:`); 99.68% is not
